Configure where CircleCI sends notifications

## Usage

`circleci notification <command> [flags]`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description                                       |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `slack` | Send a project's notifications to a Slack channel |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

Configure the channels CircleCI sends notifications to.
These commands are not available on CircleCI Server.
